# DormChef

DormChef is an iPhone app in development for college students: pick cheap, good
recipes that fit a dorm kitchen (microwave and mini-fridge included), plan the
week, and get one merged, aisle-organized grocery list with an estimated total —
the whole week's dinners, rung up before you shop.

What it does today:

- Every recipe wears its price: an estimated cost per serving, alongside
  calories, protein, carbs and fat per serving. Estimates are marked as
  estimates.
- An optional weekly budget: lists aim at your cap and suggest cheaper swaps
  where honest ones exist; it never drops an ingredient your recipes need.
- Dorm reality first: a no-kitchen filter, dietary filters, and meals that
  batch well.
- A community Explore feed of student recipes — niche communities, creator
  profiles, follows and saves.
- A daily food log with a calorie goal, fed straight from your saved and
  planned meals.

Status: in development. Early access signups at https://dormchefllc.com/.

Built by DormChef LLC (Florida). Contact: dormchef.app@gmail.com.
